hypothesis: Request243's sequential controller fails because separately trained ENTER, WAIT and HOLD value heads are not calibrated to comparable same-policy economic values. The especially compressed WAIT target may make ENTER look preferable even when waiting has greater realized continuation value.
population: Request243 May11-20 locked calibration episodes only; same Apr30-May8 chronological fit and identical causal state representation.
diagnostics: predicted versus realized same-policy ENTER value
predicted versus realized same-policy WAIT continuation
predicted ENTER-minus-WAIT advantage versus realized advantage
positive-sign precision and Spearman rank correlation
decision-reachable chosen-action advantage over its best alternative
student target support, zero mass and scale mismatch

reachable_semantics.flat: initial consecutive WAIT states plus the first ENTER or ABSTAIN state only
reachable_semantics.position: states strictly after the actual policy entry through its selected exit

forbidden: changing policy actions or model capacity
fitting any threshold or offset from May results
opening June or any new holdout
dropping unresolved values and calling the remaining subset a portfolio return
using a best-future-price or hindsight argmax target
next_if_fail: Replace independently scaled flat-state value comparison with a directly learned ENTER-vs-WAIT-vs-CASH advantage objective under chronological cross-fitting; retain HOLD-vs-EXIT as a directly comparable advantage target.
